title: Phaseout plan for legacy model versions and pinned deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We need a repeatable, low-friction deprecation workflow for old model versions that have been published in the Model Catalog and are still pinned by customers. This ticket proposes the end-to-end process: detection of versions eligible for sunset, staged notices (console + email + API), an in-console migration helper, SLO/compatibility checks, and final removal with an emergency fallback. Goal: minimize customer disruption, avoid silent breakage for pinned deployments, and keep the catalog clean so performance profiles remain accurate.
background: As we publish newer model revisions and optimal quantization/compile profiles, older artifacts accumulate. Some teams continue to pin specific versions for predictability. When we remove an old model binary or change runtime kernels, pinned customers can face outages. There is no consistent product workflow today to notify tenants, assist migrations, and schedule final sunset with SLA-aligned warnings.
proposal: Implement a standard three-stage deprecation pipeline: 1) Candidate identification and internal review (compatibility, usage, security), 2) Public warning window with automated migration tooling and performance equivalence notes, 3) Sunset execution with rollback options. Integrate notices into the Console (model page, pinned endpoint page), API (deprecation field on model metadata), and monthly customer usage emails. Provide a migration assistant that suggests nearest compatible model variant and precomputes perf profile differences (latency/cost/quality delta). For pinned endpoints, require explicit customer acknowledgement (or auto-queue migrate with 30-day notice for low-usage pins).
acceptance_criteria: System flags models as deprecation candidates based on age, maintainer tag, or flagged insecurity
Console shows deprecation banner on model and pinned endpoint pages with 'Migrate' CTA
API model metadata includes 'deprecation_notice' object (start_date, end_date, recommended_replacements) visible via model catalog endpoints
Migration assistant can generate a recommended migration plan for a pinned endpoint and estimate delta in tokens/sec and cost per 1k tokens
Customer receives three automated notices (initial, reminder @14 days, final @3 days) via email and console for pinned models
Engineering runbook exists to abort or extend sunset within 24h and re-enable legacy binary for emergency support
migration_guide_summary: Provide a short in-console guide per pinned endpoint: 1) snapshot current config and sample prompts, 2) run side-by-side quality check against recommended replacement with a small eval set (we auto-populate 10 recent prompts), 3) preview latency/cost differences, 4) choose 'Auto-migrate' or 'Schedule window' or 'Request extended support'. The guide will link to a full migration doc on Confluence with CLI/API steps and rollback commands.
notice_timeline: Day 0: Internal candidate review completed and model moved to 'Sunset Pending'
Day 7: Initial customer notice posted to console + email to org owners for pinned endpoints
Day 21: Reminder notice with migration assistant link; inline example of perf deltas for top 3 replacements
Day 28: Final notice with 'Sunset in 3 days' and warning about forced rerouting to fallback model if applicable

Day 31: Sunset window: model binaries removed from hosted pool; pinned endpoints either auto-migrated (if opted-in) or routed to fallback with throttled capacity and incident opened for customers who requested extended support
console_changes: Add a deprecation state to the Model Catalog entry with a visible banner containing start/end dates and 'Recommended replacements'. On pinned endpoint detail pages show per-endpoint migration card: sample prompts, estimated deltas, one-click 'Run sample eval' and 'Auto-migrate' toggles. Add an admin view for PM/CS to extend sunsets or flag exceptions.
api_changes: Expose new read-only fields on model catalog endpoints: 'sunset_status' (active|pending|sunset), 'sunset_start', 'sunset_end', 'recommended_replacements' (list of model slugs), and 'pin_protection' (true/false). Pinned-endpoint API returns 'migration_suggestion' when a linked model is pending sunset. No breaking changes to existing endpoints; new fields are opt-in in SDKs.
risks: Customers with strict pinned-vendor requirements may require longer retention windows
Automated migration could produce unexpected semantic differences for specialized prompts
Removal of legacy binaries might cause transient capacity pressure on recommended replacements
Edge case: on-prem/private deployments where we cannot remove binaries; requires separate contract/legal flow
monitoring_kpis: % of pinned endpoints migrated before sunset
number of support tickets opened per sunset
avg latency and token cost delta pre/post migration
rollback_plan: If critical regressions are reported within 72h of sunset, execute emergency rollback: restore legacy binary to hosted pool, re-route pinned endpoints back, open incident bridge, and extend sunset by minimum 30 days. Rollback requires Eng lead + PM sign-off and will trigger a retro to update migration heuristics.
communication_templates: Initial notice: 'Your organization has 21 days to migrate from model X. Visit Console > Models > X to see recommended replacements and a migration assistant.'
Reminder: '21 days remaining to migrate pinned endpoints using model X. Run a sample eval or request an extended support window.'
Final: '3 days until sunset for model X. Endpoints still pinned will be routed to fallback. If you require assistance, open a support request.'
